headline: Maui County Council Meeting

meeting.summary: A member said Bill 133 expands the county properties where people may temporarily live in vehicles.
meeting.recap: A member said Bill 133 expands the county properties where people may temporarily live in vehicles.[[0:23:45]] Bills 150 and 151 would allow $30 million in bond borrowing for Molokaʻi land purchases.[[0:39:19]] The vice chair said the bills do not name parcels, acreage, sellers or values.[[0:39:27]] The managing director said the county must get council approval before buying any property.[[0:45:30]] Bill 143, a firefighting mutual aid agreement with the state forestry division, passed 9–0.[[0:52:49]] The prosecuting attorney said the work supports Lahaina fraud investigations.[[1:01:46]] Bill 149 updates Affordable Housing Fund conditions and re-appropriates $2 million for a project.[[1:09:36]] A group of budget and water bills passed on second and final reading, 8–0.[[1:18:08]] Bill 134, a water resources study agreement with the U.S. Geological Survey, passed 8–0.[[1:19:55]] A staff member said a Hāna pop-up voter service center opens tomorrow, 10 to 3.[[1:24:01]]
meeting.next: A member said she will call the deputy director's office to learn the Affordable Housing Fund process.

issues.oneLine: Bill 134 lets the mayor sign a joint funding agreement to continue a water resources program with the U.S. Geological Survey.
issues.brief: The water department's share, $199,720, is already in the fiscal year 2027 budget.[[#1]] Bill 129 FD1 authorizes a loan from the state's drinking water revolving fund for water supply projects.[[#2]]

issues.why: A member said the director stressed the urgency of a managed temporary site while the permanent site is finished.
issues.next: The vice chair asked for a copy of the department's rules for the site.
issues.brief: An amendment lets the county approve cooking at sites, such as with food trucks.[[#1]] A member said she wants to see progress a year from now because this is a pilot.[[#2]] Bill 149 updates Affordable Housing Fund conditions and re-appropriates $2 million for a project.[[#3]]
